method: HADDOCK-inspired interface analysis with SKEMPI v2 validation
definition: Distance-based interface identification + simplified HADDOCK scoring + experimental ddG validation
assumptions: Static crystal structure adequately represents the bound complex
5.0 A cutoff captures relevant interface residues
4.0 A cutoff identifies meaningful atomic contacts
Simplified LJ and Coulomb potentials capture qualitative trends
SKEMPI v2 ddG values computed at standard temperature (298.15 K)
invariants: Interface residues must have at least one heavy atom within 5 A of partner
Contacts classified by atom type and distance criteria
non_negotiable_steps: ddG computation from experimental Kd values
deviations_from_full_HADDOCK: No AIR-driven docking (analysis of existing structure only)
